exampleZh: …性别平等。
exampleEn: ...equality of the sexes.

meaning: n. 刺眼；耀眼的光；受公众注目；v. 瞪眼表示
meaningZh: n. 刺眼；耀眼的光；受公众注目；v. 瞪眼表示
meaningEn: n. a bright unpleasant light which hurts your eyes
example: a special screen to reduce glare
exampleZh: 一种可以减弱刺眼强光的特殊屏幕
exampleEn: a special screen to reduce glare

meaning: v. 使丧失，剥夺
meaningZh: v. 使丧失，剥夺
meaningEn: v. If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it
example: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
exampleZh: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。
exampleEn: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.

meaning: v. 冒烟；发怒；n. 烟；愤怒，烦恼
meaningZh: v. 冒烟；发怒；n. 烟；愤怒，烦恼
meaningEn: v. to give off smoke or gases；n. Fumes are the unpleasant and often unhealthy smoke and gases that are produced by fires or by things such as chemicals, fuel, or cooking
example: ...car exhaust fumes.
exampleZh: …汽车尾气。
exampleEn: ...car exhaust fumes.

meaning: n. 前言；引语；v. 为…加序言；以…开始
meaningZh: n. 前言；引语；v. 为…加序言；以…开始
meaningEn: n. an introduction at the beginning of a book or speech；v. If you preface an action or speech with something else, you do or say this other thing first
example: ...the preface to Kelman's novel.
exampleZh: …凯尔曼小说的前言。
exampleEn: ...the preface to Kelman's novel.

meaning: n. 大会；[法] 惯例；[计] 约定；[法] 协定；习俗
meaningZh: n. 大会；[法] 惯例；[计] 约定；[法] 协定；习俗
meaningEn: n. a large formal meeting for people who belong to the same profession or organization or who have the same interests
example: a teachers’ convention
exampleZh: 教师大会
exampleEn: a teachers’ convention

meaning: v. 高飞；高耸；往上飞舞；n. 高飞；高涨
meaningZh: v. 高飞；高耸；往上飞舞；n. 高飞；高涨
meaningEn: v. if your  spirits (= the way you are feeling, for example happy, sad etc )  or hopes soar, you begin to feel very happy or hopeful
example: Adam’s smile sent her spirits soaring .
exampleZh: 亚当的微笑让她飘飘然了。
exampleEn: Adam’s smile sent her spirits soaring .

meaning: n. 小船；轮船；v. 划船
meaningZh: n. 小船；轮船；v. 划船
meaningEn: n. a vehicle that travels across water
example: a fishing boat
exampleZh: 渔船
exampleEn: a fishing boat

meaning: n. 运河；[地理] 水道；[建] 管道；灌溉水渠；v. 在…开凿运河
meaningZh: n. 运河；[地理] 水道；[建] 管道；灌溉水渠；v. 在…开凿运河
meaningEn: n. a long passage dug into the ground and filled with water, either for boats to travel along, or to take water to a place
example: We walked along by the side of the canal.
exampleZh: 我们沿着运河边往前走。
exampleEn: We walked along by the side of the canal.

meaning: adj. 有义务的；必定的；受约束的；装有封面的；v. 束缚；使跳跃；n. 范围；跳跃
meaningZh: adj. 有义务的；必定的；受约束的；装有封面的；v. 束缚；使跳跃；n. 范围；跳跃
meaningEn: adj. to be forced to do what a law or agreement says you must do；n. a long or high jump made with a lot of energy
example: You are legally bound to report the accident.
exampleZh: 法律上你有责任报告这起事故。
exampleEn: You are legally bound to report the accident.

meaning: n. 版本
meaningZh: n. 版本
meaningEn: n. the form that a book, newspaper, magazine etc is produced in
example: a paperback edition
exampleZh: 平装本
exampleEn: a paperback edition

meaning: v. 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加；n. 火箭
meaningZh: v. 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加；n. 火箭
meaningEn: v. to move somewhere very fast；n. a vehicle used for travelling or carrying things into space, which is shaped like a big tube
example: The train rocketed through the tunnel.
exampleZh: 火车高速穿过隧道。
exampleEn: The train rocketed through the tunnel.

meaning: adj. 快速的，敏捷的；n. 舰队；港湾；小河；v. 飞逝；疾驰；掠过
meaningZh: adj. 快速的，敏捷的；n. 舰队；港湾；小河；v. 飞逝；疾驰；掠过
meaningEn: adj. fast or quick；n. a group of ships, or all the ships in a navy
example: Atalanta was fleet of foot (= able to run quickly ) .
exampleZh: 阿塔兰特跑起来很快。
exampleEn: Atalanta was fleet of foot (= able to run quickly ) .

meaning: adj. 口头的，口述的；n. 口试
meaningZh: adj. 口头的，口述的；n. 口试
meaningEn: adj. spoken, not written；n. a spoken test, especially in a foreign language
example: oral history
exampleZh: 口述的历史
exampleEn: oral history

meaning: n. 模仿，仿造；仿制品；adj. 人造的，仿制的
meaningZh: n. 模仿，仿造；仿制品；adj. 人造的，仿制的
meaningEn: n. when you copy someone else’s actions；adj. Imitation things are not genuine but are made to look as if they are
example: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.
exampleZh: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。
exampleEn: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (= something that is much less good than the thing it imitates ) of the original movie.

meaning: n. 步行，走；散步；v. 散步；走过
meaningZh: n. 步行，走；散步；v. 散步；走过
meaningEn: n. a journey that you make by walking, especially for exercise or enjoyment；v. When you walk, you move forward by putting one foot in front of the other in a regular way
example: It’s a long walk. Maybe we should get the bus.
exampleZh: 走着去很远，或许我们应该乘公共汽车。
exampleEn: It’s a long walk. Maybe we should get the bus.

meaning: n. 便利；厕所；便利的事物
meaningZh: n. 便利；厕所；便利的事物
meaningEn: n. the quality of being suitable or useful for a particular purpose, especially by making something easier or saving you time
example: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
exampleZh: 即食餐因为方便销路好。
exampleEn: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.

meaning: n. [数] 精确度，准确性
meaningZh: n. [数] 精确度，准确性
meaningEn: n. the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake
example: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
exampleZh: 他传球准确无误。
exampleEn: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.

meaning: v. 指导；通知；命令；教授
meaningZh: v. 指导；通知；命令；教授
meaningEn: v. to officially tell someone what to do
example: Eva went straight to the hotel, as instructed (= as she had been told ).
exampleZh: 伊娃按照指示径直去了宾馆。
exampleEn: Eva went straight to the hotel, as instructed (= as she had been told ).

meaning: n. 童年时期；幼年时代
meaningZh: n. 童年时期；幼年时代
meaningEn: n. the period of time when you are a child
example: I had a very happy childhood.
exampleZh: 我的童年很快乐。
exampleEn: I had a very happy childhood.

meaning: v. 使文明；教化；使开化
meaningZh: v. 使文明；教化；使开化
meaningEn: v. to influence someone’s behaviour, making or teaching them to act in a more sensible or gentle way
example: The missionaries went out to civilize other places.
exampleZh: 传教士们去异国他乡教化当地人民。
exampleEn: The missionaries went out to civilize other places.

meaning: v. 尊敬；认为；考虑；估价；n. 尊重；尊敬
meaningZh: v. 尊敬；认为；考虑；估价；n. 尊重；尊敬
meaningEn: v. to respect and admire someone or something；n. a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone
example: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
exampleZh: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。
exampleEn: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.

meaning: adj. 勤勉的；用功的，费尽心血的；n. (Diligent)人名；(法)迪利让
meaningZh: adj. 勤勉的；用功的，费尽心血的；n. (Diligent)人名；(法)迪利让
meaningEn: adj. someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough
example: a diligent student
exampleZh: 勤勉的学生
exampleEn: a diligent student

meaning: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应
meaningZh: n. 接待；接收；招待会；感受；反应
meaningEn: n. a particular type of welcome for someone, or a particular type of reaction to their ideas, work etc
example: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
exampleZh: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。
exampleEn: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.

meaning: v. 组成，构成；建立；任命
meaningZh: v. 组成，构成；建立；任命
meaningEn: v. if several people or things constitute something, they are the parts that form it
example: We must redefine what constitutes a family.
exampleZh: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。
exampleEn: We must redefine what constitutes a family.

meaning: n. 邀请；引诱；请帖；邀请函
meaningZh: n. 邀请；引诱；请帖；邀请函
meaningEn: n. a written or spoken request to someone, inviting them to go somewhere or do something
example: They were always dropping by, usually without invitation.
exampleZh: 他们常常来串门，通常不请自来。
exampleEn: They were always dropping by, usually without invitation.

meaning: v. 钻孔；n. 孔；令人讨厌的人
meaningZh: v. 钻孔；n. 孔；令人讨厌的人
meaningEn: v. to make a deep round hole in a hard surface；n. something that is not interesting to you or that annoys you
example: Get the special drill bit to bore the correct size hole for the job.
exampleZh: 找个特殊的钻头，钻个尺寸合适的孔。
exampleEn: Get the special drill bit to bore the correct size hole for the job.

meaning: adj. 本质的，固有的
meaningZh: adj. 本质的，固有的
meaningEn: adj. being part of the nature or character of someone or something
example: the intrinsic interest of the subject
exampleZh: 该话题本身的趣味
exampleEn: the intrinsic interest of the subject

meaning: n. 剩余；[贸易] 顺差；盈余；过剩；adj. 剩余的；过剩的
meaningZh: n. 剩余；[贸易] 顺差；盈余；过剩；adj. 剩余的；过剩的
meaningEn: n. an amount of something that is more than what is needed or used；adj. more than what is needed or used
example: Any surplus can be trimmed away.
exampleZh: 多出来的部分可以修剪掉。
exampleEn: Any surplus can be trimmed away.

meaning: n. 混合；混合物；混合剂
meaningZh: n. 混合；混合物；混合剂
meaningEn: n. a combination of two or more different things, feelings, or types of people
example: Pour the mixture into four small dishes.
exampleZh: 把混合料倒入四个小碟子里。
exampleEn: Pour the mixture into four small dishes.

meaning: v. 授予；给予；n. (Confer)人名；(英)康弗
meaningZh: v. 授予；给予；n. (Confer)人名；(英)康弗
meaningEn: v. to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved
example: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
exampleZh: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。
exampleEn: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.

meaning: adj. 值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的；n. 杰出人物；知名人士
meaningZh: adj. 值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的；n. 杰出人物；知名人士
meaningEn: adj. deserving respect from people；n. someone who is important and should be respected
example: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.
exampleZh: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。
exampleEn: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.

meaning: n. 开业者，从业者，执业医生
meaningZh: n. 开业者，从业者，执业医生

example: a practitioner of alternative medicine
exampleZh: 非常规医学的执业医生
exampleEn: a practitioner of alternative medicine

meaning: adj. 经验主义的，完全根据经验的；实证的
meaningZh: adj. 经验主义的，完全根据经验的；实证的
meaningEn: adj. based on scientific testing or practical experience, not on ideas
example: {"COLLOINEXA":["empirical evidence"]}
exampleZh: 实验证据
exampleEn: {"COLLOINEXA":["empirical evidence"]}

meaning: n. 工程，工程学；v. 设计；管理（engineer的ing形式）；建造
meaningZh: n. 工程，工程学；v. 设计；管理（engineer的ing形式）；建造
meaningEn: n. the work involved in designing and building roads, bridges, machines etc
example: Their inventions have contributed to the development of electrical engineering.
exampleZh: 他们的发明有助于电气工程学的发展。
exampleEn: Their inventions have contributed to the development of electrical engineering.

meaning: adj. 文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的；n. 文盲

meaningEn: adj. someone who is illiterate has not learned to read or write；n. someone who has not learned to read or write
example: It was an illiterate letter, full of mistakes.
exampleZh: 这封信文笔拙劣，错误连篇。
exampleEn: It was an illiterate letter, full of mistakes.

meaning: adj. 丰富的；充裕的；盛产
meaningZh: adj. 丰富的；充裕的；盛产

example: an abundant supply of fresh water
exampleZh: 充足的淡水供应
exampleEn: an abundant supply of fresh water

meaningZh: v. 扭曲；使失真；曲解

example: His account was badly distorted by the press.
exampleZh: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。
exampleEn: His account was badly distorted by the press.

meaning: n. 私语；谣传；飒飒的声音；v. 耳语；密谈；飒飒地响
meaningZh: n. 私语；谣传；飒飒的声音；v. 耳语；密谈；飒飒地响
meaningEn: n. a piece of news or information that has not been officially announced and may or may not be true；v. to speak or say something very quietly, using your breath rather than your voice
example: You don’t have to whisper, no one can hear us.
exampleZh: 你不必轻声轻语，没人听得到我们说话。
exampleEn: You don’t have to whisper, no one can hear us.

meaning: n. 打字机
meaningZh: n. 打字机

example: She tapped out a letter on the typewriter.
exampleZh: 她用打字机打出了一封信。
exampleEn: She tapped out a letter on the typewriter.

meaning: n. 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物；adj. 记忆的；纪念的，追悼的
meaningZh: n. 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物；adj. 记忆的；纪念的，追悼的
meaningEn: n. something, especially a stone with writing on it, that reminds people of someone who has died；adj. done or made in order to remind people of someone who has died
example: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.
exampleZh: 建一座哥伦布纪念碑一直是他一生的梦想。
exampleEn: Building a memorial to Columbus has been his lifelong dream.

meaning: n. 病房；保卫；监视；v. 避开；保卫；守护
meaningZh: n. 病房；保卫；监视；v. 避开；保卫；守护
meaningEn: n. a large room in a hospital where people who need medical treatment stay
example: the other patients in the ward
exampleZh: 病房里的其他病人
exampleEn: the other patients in the ward

meaning: n. 肉；肉体；v. 喂肉给…；使发胖
meaningZh: n. 肉；肉体；v. 喂肉给…；使发胖
meaningEn: n. the soft part of the body of a person or animal that is between the skin and the bones
example: a freshwater fish with firm white flesh
exampleZh: 一种肉色雪白、肉质紧实的淡水鱼
exampleEn: a freshwater fish with firm white flesh

meaning: v. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；n. 偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；断球
meaningZh: v. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；n. 偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；断球
meaningEn: v. to take something that belongs to someone else；n. to be very cheap
example: Boys broke into a shop and stole £45 in cash.
exampleZh: 男孩们闯进一家商店，盗走了45英镑现金。
exampleEn: Boys broke into a shop and stole £45 in cash.

meaning: v. 使震惊；打昏；给以深刻的印象；n. 昏迷；打昏；惊倒；令人惊叹的事物
meaningZh: v. 使震惊；打昏；给以深刻的印象；n. 昏迷；打昏；惊倒；令人惊叹的事物
meaningEn: v. to surprise or upset someone so much that they do not react immediately
example: Redfern stunned the crowd with a last-minute goal.
exampleZh: 雷德芬在最后一分钟进球，使观众很是震惊。
exampleEn: Redfern stunned the crowd with a last-minute goal.

meaning: v. 仔细考虑；衡量；n. (Ponder)人名；(英)庞德
meaningZh: v. 仔细考虑；衡量；n. (Ponder)人名；(英)庞德
meaningEn: v. to spend time thinking carefully and seriously about a problem, a difficult question, or something that has happened
example: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
exampleZh: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。
exampleEn: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.

meaning: v. 控告，指控；谴责；归咎于
meaningZh: v. 控告，指控；谴责；归咎于
meaningEn: v. to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad
example: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
exampleZh: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。
exampleEn: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.

meaning: n. 运动员；运动家；冒险家
meaningZh: n. 运动员；运动家；冒险家
meaningEn: n. a man who plays several different sports
example: He’s a very keen sportsman .
exampleZh: 他是个非常喜爱运动的人。
exampleEn: He’s a very keen sportsman .

meaning: v. 引导；踢；解雇；使穿靴；n. 靴子；踢；汽车行李箱
meaningZh: v. 引导；踢；解雇；使穿靴；n. 靴子；踢；汽车行李箱
meaningEn: v. to kick someone or something hard；n. a type of shoe that covers your whole foot and the lower part of your leg
example: hiking boots
exampleZh: 远足靴
exampleEn: hiking boots

meaning: adj. 陡峭的；不合理的；夸大的；急剧升降的；v. 泡；浸；使…充满；n. 峭壁；浸渍
meaningZh: adj. 陡峭的；不合理的；夸大的；急剧升降的；v. 泡；浸；使…充满；n. 峭壁；浸渍

example: The road became rocky and steep.
exampleZh: 路变得崎岖陡峭起来。
exampleEn: The road became rocky and steep.

meaningZh: adj. 手工的；体力的；n. 手册，指南

example: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.
exampleZh: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。
exampleEn: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.

meaning: v. 控制，引导；驾驶；n. 阉牛
meaningZh: v. 控制，引导；驾驶；n. 阉牛

example: He was steering with only one hand.
exampleZh: 他只用一只手在驾驶。
exampleEn: He was steering with only one hand.

meaning: n. 铅笔；笔状物；v. 用铅笔写；用眉笔涂
meaningZh: n. 铅笔；笔状物；v. 用铅笔写；用眉笔涂
meaningEn: n. an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a wooden stick with a thin piece of a black or coloured substance in the middle；v. to write something or make a mark with a pencil
example: a sharp pencil
exampleZh: 尖尖的铅笔
exampleEn: a sharp pencil

meaning: n. [数][计] 序列；顺序；续发事件；v. 按顺序排好
meaningZh: n. [数][计] 序列；顺序；续发事件；v. 按顺序排好

meaning: v. 取消；删去；n. 取消，撤销
meaningZh: v. 取消；删去；n. 取消，撤销
meaningEn: v. to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen
example: Our flight was cancelled.
exampleZh: 我们的航班取消了。
exampleEn: Our flight was cancelled.

meaning: n. 浴室；厕所；盥洗室
meaningZh: n. 浴室；厕所；盥洗室
meaningEn: n. a room where there is a bath or  shower  , a  basin  , and sometimes a toilet
example: Where’s the bathroom?
exampleZh: 洗手间在哪里？
exampleEn: Where’s the bathroom?

meaning: adj. 合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的；n. 合格者；适任者；有资格者
meaningZh: adj. 合格的，合适的；符合条件的；有资格当选的；n. 合格者；适任者；有资格者
meaningEn: adj. someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age
example: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.
exampleZh: 斯蒂芬被认为是一个钻石王老五。
exampleEn: Stephen was regarded as an eligible bachelor.

meaning: n. 手册；指南
meaningZh: n. 手册；指南
meaningEn: n. a short book that gives information or instructions about something
example: the Fiction Writer’s Handbook
exampleZh: 《小说写作手册》
exampleEn: the Fiction Writer’s Handbook

meaning: v. 编织；结合；皱眉；n. 编织衣物；编织法
meaningZh: v. 编织；结合；皱眉；n. 编织衣物；编织法
meaningEn: v. to make clothing out of wool, using two knitting needles
example: My grandmother taught me how to knit.
exampleZh: 我祖母教过我编织。
exampleEn: My grandmother taught me how to knit.

meaning: n. 餐后甜点；甜点心
meaningZh: n. 餐后甜点；甜点心
meaningEn: n. sweet food served after the main part of a meal
example: She had homemade ice cream for dessert.
exampleZh: 她吃了些自制冰淇淋当餐后甜点。
exampleEn: She had homemade ice cream for dessert.

meaning: n. 诗，诗篇；韵文；诗节；v. 作诗
meaningZh: n. 诗，诗篇；韵文；诗节；v. 作诗
meaningEn: n. a set of lines that forms one part of a song, poem, or a book such as the Bible or the Koran
example: Let’s sing the last verse again.
exampleZh: 我们把最后一节再唱一遍吧。
exampleEn: Let’s sing the last verse again.

meaning: adj. 浅的；肤浅的；n. [地理] 浅滩；v. 使变浅
meaningZh: adj. 浅的；肤浅的；n. [地理] 浅滩；v. 使变浅
meaningEn: adj. measuring only a short distance from the top to the bottom
example: a shallow river
exampleZh: 浅河
exampleEn: a shallow river

meaning: v. 打气；用抽水机抽…；n. 泵，抽水机；打气筒
meaningZh: v. 打气；用抽水机抽…；n. 泵，抽水机；打气筒
meaningEn: v. To pump a liquid or gas in a particular direction means to force it to flow in that direction using a pump；n. a machine for forcing liquid or gas into or out of something
example: It's not enough to get rid of raw sewage by pumping it out to sea.
exampleZh: 仅用水泵将未经处理的污水排入海中是不够的。
exampleEn: It's not enough to get rid of raw sewage by pumping it out to sea.

meaning: n. 投入；输入电路；v. [自][电子] 输入；将…输入电脑
meaningZh: n. 投入；输入电路；v. [自][电子] 输入；将…输入电脑
meaningEn: n. ideas, advice, money, or effort that you put into a job or activity in order to help it succeed；v. If you input information into a computer, you feed it in, for example, by typing it on a keyboard
example: If the input data specified it, the file will close and the process terminates.
exampleZh: 如果输入数据指定，该文件就会关闭，数据处理终止。
exampleEn: If the input data specified it, the file will close and the process terminates.

meaning: n. 笔迹；书法；书写；手稿；v. 亲手写（handwrite的ing形式）
meaningZh: n. 笔迹；书法；书写；手稿；v. 亲手写（handwrite的ing形式）
meaningEn: n. the style of someone’s writing
example: I recognised her handwriting on the envelope.
exampleZh: 我认出了信封上她的笔迹。
exampleEn: I recognised her handwriting on the envelope.

meaning: v. 花费；消耗；用光；耗尽
meaningZh: v. 花费；消耗；用光；耗尽
meaningEn: v. to use or spend a lot of energy etc in order to do something
example: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.
exampleZh: 孩子们耗能多，可能比成人需要更多高能量的食物。
exampleEn: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.

meaning: adj. 即将来临的；n. 来临
meaningZh: adj. 即将来临的；n. 来临
meaningEn: adj. a forthcoming event, meeting etc is one that has been planned to happen soon
example: the forthcoming elections
exampleZh: 即将到来的选举
exampleEn: the forthcoming elections

meaning: n. 王子，国君；亲王；贵族
meaningZh: n. 王子，国君；亲王；贵族
meaningEn: n. the son of a king, queen, or prince
example: Prince William
exampleZh: 威廉王子
exampleEn: Prince William

meaning: adj. 宽容的；容忍的；有耐药力的
meaningZh: adj. 宽容的；容忍的；有耐药力的
meaningEn: adj. allowing people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them
example: a tolerant society
exampleZh: 宽容的社会
exampleEn: a tolerant society

meaning: v. 实施，执行；实现，使生效；n. 工具，器具；手段
meaningZh: v. 实施，执行；实现，使生效；n. 工具，器具；手段
meaningEn: v. to take action or make changes that you have officially decided should happen；n. a tool, especially one used for outdoor physical work
example: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions.
exampleZh: 政府许诺要实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。
exampleEn: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions.

meaning: n. 群；串；突出物；v. 隆起；打褶；形成一串
meaningZh: n. 群；串；突出物；v. 隆起；打褶；形成一串
meaningEn: n. a group of things that are fastened, held, or growing together；v. to pull material together tightly in folds
example: Lili had fallen asleep clutching a fat bunch of grapes.
exampleZh: 莉莉手里抓着一大串葡萄睡着了。
exampleEn: Lili had fallen asleep clutching a fat bunch of grapes.

meaning: adj. 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的；n. 平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西；adv. 清楚地；平易地
meaningZh: adj. 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的；n. 平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西；adv. 清楚地；平易地
meaningEn: adj. in clear and simple words, without using technical language；n. a large area of flat dry land
example: The document, written in plain English, tells you about your new policy.
exampleZh: 这份文件用简明的英语写成，解释了你们的新政策。
exampleEn: The document, written in plain English, tells you about your new policy.

meaning: adj. 犯规的；邪恶的；污秽的；淤塞的；v. 犯规；弄脏；淤塞；缠住，妨害；n. 犯规；缠绕；adv. 违反规则地，不正当地
meaningZh: adj. 犯规的；邪恶的；污秽的；淤塞的；v. 犯规；弄脏；淤塞；缠住，妨害；n. 犯规；缠绕；adv. 违反规则地，不正当地
meaningEn: adj. very dirty；v. to make something very dirty, especially with waste；n. an action in a sport that is against the rules
example: Refugees in the camps are short of food and at risk from foul water.
exampleZh: 营中难民缺少食物，还面临水源污染的危险。
exampleEn: Refugees in the camps are short of food and at risk from foul water.

meaning: v. 查阅；商量；向…请教
meaningZh: v. 查阅；商量；向…请教
meaningEn: v. to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something
example: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
exampleZh: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。
exampleEn: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.

meaning: n. 阶梯；途径；梯状物；v. 成名；发迹
meaningZh: n. 阶梯；途径；梯状物；v. 成名；发迹
meaningEn: n. a piece of equipment used for climbing up to or down from high places. A ladder has two bars that are connected by rungs(= short bars that you use as steps ) .
example: She climbed up the ladder.
exampleZh: 她爬上梯子。
exampleEn: She climbed up the ladder.

meaning: adj. 摄氏的；[仪] 摄氏温度的；百分度的
meaningZh: adj. 摄氏的；[仪] 摄氏温度的；百分度的
meaningEn: adj. Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees. It is represented by the symbol °C.
example: ...daytime temperatures of up to forty degrees centigrade.
exampleZh: …高达40摄氏度的日间气温。
exampleEn: ...daytime temperatures of up to forty degrees centigrade.

meaning: n. 困境；进退两难；两刀论法
meaningZh: n. 困境；进退两难；两刀论法
meaningEn: n. a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what to do, because all the choices seem equally good or equally bad
example: a moral dilemma
exampleZh: 道德上进退两难的窘境
exampleEn: a moral dilemma

meaning: v. 停止；立定；踌躇，犹豫；n. 停止；立定；休息
meaningZh: v. 停止；立定；踌躇，犹豫；n. 停止；立定；休息
meaningEn: v. to prevent someone or something from continuing - used especially in news reports；n. a stop or pause
example: The government has failed to halt economic decline.
exampleZh: 政府没能阻止经济衰退。
exampleEn: The government has failed to halt economic decline.

meaning: n. 农村，乡下；乡下的全体居民
meaningZh: n. 农村，乡下；乡下的全体居民
meaningEn: n. land that is outside cities and towns
example: The house had lovely views over open countryside .
exampleZh: 这房子望出去是开阔的乡村美景。
exampleEn: The house had lovely views over open countryside .

meaning: v. 转播；接替；n. [电] 继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马
meaningZh: v. 转播；接替；n. [电] 继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马
meaningEn: v. if radio or television signals are relayed, they are received and sent, especially so that they can be heard on the radio or seen on television
example: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.
exampleZh: 这些电视节目通过卫星进行转播。
exampleEn: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.

meaning: v. 概括；推广；使一般化
meaningZh: v. 概括；推广；使一般化
meaningEn: v. to form a general principle or opinion after considering only a small number of facts or examples
example: Can we generalise this principle?
exampleZh: 这个原理可以推而广之吗？
exampleEn: Can we generalise this principle?

meaning: adj. 挖苦的；尖刻的，辛辣的
meaningZh: adj. 挖苦的；尖刻的，辛辣的
meaningEn: adj. saying things that are the opposite of what you mean, in order to make an unkind joke or to show that you are annoyed
example: Was she being sarcastic?
exampleZh: 她是在嘲讽吗？
exampleEn: Was she being sarcastic?

meaning: n. 参考书目；文献目录
meaningZh: n. 参考书目；文献目录
meaningEn: n. a list of all the books and articles used in preparing a piece of writing
example: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
exampleZh: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。
exampleEn: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.

meaning: n. 经销商；商人
meaningZh: n. 经销商；商人
meaningEn: n. someone who buys and sells a particular product, especially an expensive one
example: ...an antique dealer.
exampleZh: …一位古董商。
exampleEn: ...an antique dealer.

meaning: adj. 循环的；圆形的；间接的；n. 通知，传单
meaningZh: adj. 循环的；圆形的；间接的；n. 通知，传单
meaningEn: adj. shaped like a circle
example: a circular table
exampleZh: 圆桌
exampleEn: a circular table

meaning: n. 机场；航空站
meaningZh: n. 机场；航空站
meaningEn: n. a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in
example: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
exampleZh: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。
exampleEn: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.

meaning: adj. [数] 周期的；定期的；n. 期刊；杂志
meaningZh: adj. [数] 周期的；定期的；n. 期刊；杂志
meaningEn: adj. Periodical events or situations happen occasionally, at fairly regular intervals；n. a magazine, especially one about a serious or technical subject
example: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
exampleZh: 她定期去看牙医。
exampleEn: She made periodical visits to her dentist.

meaning: adj. 残忍的；野蛮的，不讲理的
meaningZh: adj. 残忍的；野蛮的，不讲理的
meaningEn: adj. very cruel and violent
example: a brutal man
exampleZh: 一个凶残的男人
exampleEn: a brutal man

meaning: n. [仪] 投影仪；放映机；探照灯；设计者
meaningZh: n. [仪] 投影仪；放映机；探照灯；设计者
meaningEn: n. a piece of equipment that makes a film or picture appear on a screen or flat surface
example: ...a slide projector.
exampleZh: …幻灯机。
exampleEn: ...a slide projector.

meaning: adj. 坚定的；强健的；健全的；n. 羊晕倒病
meaningZh: adj. 坚定的；强健的；健全的；n. 羊晕倒病
meaningEn: adj. someone who is sturdy is strong, short, and healthy looking
example: a sturdy young man
exampleZh: 健壮的小伙子
exampleEn: a sturdy young man

meaning: n. 哈欠；裂口；v. 打哈欠；裂开
meaningZh: n. 哈欠；裂口；v. 打哈欠；裂开
meaningEn: n. Yawn is also a noun；v. to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored
example: Rosanna stifled a huge yawn.
exampleZh: 罗莎娜忍住了一个大哈欠。
exampleEn: Rosanna stifled a huge yawn.

meaning: n. 灰；灰烬
meaningZh: n. 灰；灰烬
meaningEn: n. the soft grey powder that remains after something has been burned
example: cigarette ash
exampleZh: 香烟灰
exampleEn: cigarette ash

meaning: n. 插头；塞子；栓；v. 塞住；用插头将与电源接通
meaningZh: n. 插头；塞子；栓；v. 塞住；用插头将与电源接通
meaningEn: n. a round flat piece of rubber used for stopping the water flowing out of a bath or  sink；v. to fill or block a small hole
example: the bath plug
exampleZh: 浴缸塞子
exampleEn: the bath plug

meaning: n. 野餐；v. 去野餐
meaningZh: n. 野餐；v. 去野餐
meaningEn: n. if you have a picnic, you take food and eat it outdoors, especially in the country；v. to have a picnic
example: We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.
exampleZh: 我们决定在湖边野餐。
exampleEn: We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.

meaning: n. 明天；未来；adv. 明天；未来地（等于to-morrow）
meaningZh: n. 明天；未来；adv. 明天；未来地（等于to-morrow）
meaningEn: n. the day after today；adv. on or during the day after today
example: I’ll see you at tomorrow’s meeting.
exampleZh: 明天会上见。
exampleEn: I’ll see you at tomorrow’s meeting.

meaning: v. 运送，乘船；以船运送；n. 船；舰；太空船
meaningZh: v. 运送，乘船；以船运送；n. 船；舰；太空船
meaningEn: v. to send goods somewhere by ship, plane, truck etc；n. a large boat used for carrying people or goods across the sea
example: We'll ship your order to the address we print on your cheques.
exampleZh: 我们将把你预订的货物送到我们印在你单据上的地址。
exampleEn: We'll ship your order to the address we print on your cheques.

meaning: n. 桶，提桶
meaningZh: n. 桶，提桶
meaningEn: n. a metal or wooden container with a handle, used for carrying liquids
example: a milk pail
exampleZh: 牛奶桶
exampleEn: a milk pail

meaning: n. 陌生人；外地人；局外人
meaningZh: n. 陌生人；外地人；局外人
meaningEn: n. someone that you do not know
example: Children must not talk to strangers.
exampleZh: 小孩子千万不要同陌生人说话。
exampleEn: Children must not talk to strangers.

meaning: adj. 定性的；质的，性质上的
meaningZh: adj. 定性的；质的，性质上的
meaningEn: adj. relating to the quality or standard of something rather than the quantity
example: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
exampleZh: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。
exampleEn: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.

meaning: n. 魅力；魔法；迷人的美（等于glamour）；vt. 迷惑；使有魅力（等于glamour）
meaningZh: n. 魅力；魔法；迷人的美（等于glamour）；vt. 迷惑；使有魅力（等于glamour）
meaningEn: n. attractive or exciting charm; v. to make something seem glamorous
example: But when it comes down to it, we cannot ignore a film franchise that has been successfully thrilling us with action and glamor for over 40 years.
exampleZh: 但是说起这类影片的时候，我们就无法忽视一部电影的特殊魅力。 它成功地运用动作特技和魅力吸引了我们40多年。
exampleEn: But when it comes down to it, we cannot ignore a film franchise that has been successfully thrilling us with action and glamor for over 40 years.

meaning: v. 吐痰；吐口水；发出劈啪声；n. 唾液
meaningZh: v. 吐痰；吐口水；发出劈啪声；n. 唾液
meaningEn: v. to force a small amount of  saliva (= the liquid in your mouth )  out of your mouth；n. the watery liquid that is produced in your mouth
example: Nick rolled down his window and spat.
exampleZh: 尼克摇下窗子，啐了口唾沫。
exampleEn: Nick rolled down his window and spat.

meaning: v. 使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失
meaningZh: v. 使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失
meaningEn: v. if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas
example: Most of the water had evaporated.
exampleZh: 大部分的水都蒸发了。
exampleEn: Most of the water had evaporated.

meaning: v. 旋转；纺纱；吐丝；晕眩；n. 旋转；疾驰
meaningZh: v. 旋转；纺纱；吐丝；晕眩；n. 旋转；疾驰
meaningEn: v. to turn around and around very quickly, or to make something do this；n. an act of turning around quickly
example: The plane’s propellers were spinning.
exampleZh: 飞机的螺旋桨在快速旋转。
exampleEn: The plane’s propellers were spinning.

meaning: n. 垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱；v. 乱丢；给…垫褥草；把…弄得乱七八糟
meaningZh: n. 垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱；v. 乱丢；给…垫褥草；把…弄得乱七八糟
meaningEn: n. waste paper, cans etc that people have thrown away and left on the ground in a public place；v. if things litter an area, there are a lot of them in that place, scattered in an untidy way
example: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
exampleZh: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。
exampleEn: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.

meaning: adj. 以前的；在前部的；n. 前部；船头；adv. 在前面；在船头；prep. 在前；int. （打高尔夫球者的叫声）让开！
meaningZh: adj. 以前的；在前部的；n. 前部；船头；adv. 在前面；在船头；prep. 在前；int. （打高尔夫球者的叫声）让开！
meaningEn: adj. the fore parts of a ship, plane, or animal are the parts at the front；n. the front part；adv. at or towards a ship's bow
example: There had been no direct damage in the fore part of the ship.
exampleZh: 没有对船的前部造成直接损坏。
exampleEn: There had been no direct damage in the fore part of the ship.

meaning: v. 发低哼声；n. 嗡嗡声；哼声；杂声；int. 哼；嗯
meaningZh: v. 发低哼声；n. 嗡嗡声；哼声；杂声；int. 哼；嗯
meaningEn: v. to sing a tune by making a continuous sound with your lips closed；n. a low continuous sound
example: He began to hum a tune.
exampleZh: 他开始哼唱一支曲子。
exampleEn: He began to hum a tune.

meaning: n. 矛，枪；v. 用矛刺
meaningZh: n. 矛，枪；v. 用矛刺
meaningEn: n. a pole with a sharp pointed blade at one end, used as a weapon in the past；v. to push or throw a spear into something, especially in order to kill it
example: I fended off his sword thrust with my spear.
exampleZh: 他一刀砍来， 我拿枪架住。

meaningEn: v. to praise someone in order to please them or get something from them, even though you do not mean it
example: Perry would always flatter Mrs. Mitchell by praising her cooking.
exampleZh: 佩里常常奉承米切尔太太，称赞她的烹调手艺。
exampleEn: Perry would always flatter Mrs. Mitchell by praising her cooking.

meaning: adj. 小数的；十进位的；n. 小数
meaningZh: adj. 小数的；十进位的；n. 小数
meaningEn: adj. a decimal system is based on the number 10；n. a  fraction (= a number less than 1 )  that is shown as a  full stop  followed by the number of  tenth s  ,  hundredth s  etc. The numbers 0.5, 0.175, and 0.661 are decimals.
example: changing to a decimal system
exampleZh: 改为十进制
exampleEn: changing to a decimal system

meaning: v. 诊断；断定
meaningZh: v. 诊断；断定
meaningEn: v. to find out what illness someone has, or what the cause of a fault is, after doing tests, examinations etc
example: How did they diagnose you?
exampleZh: 他们怎么给你的诊断的？
exampleEn: How did they diagnose you?

meaning: n. 醋
meaningZh: n. 醋
meaningEn: n. a sour-tasting liquid made from malt or wine that is used to improve the taste of food or to preserve it
example: The  sugared  vinegar is  refined from the sugarcane and  pine.
exampleZh: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.
exampleEn: The  sugared  vinegar is  refined from the sugarcane and  pine.

meaning: v. 感染，传染
meaningZh: v. 感染，传染
meaningEn: v. to give someone a disease
example: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
exampleZh: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。
exampleEn: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.

meaning: n. 服装，装束；戏装，剧装；v. 给…穿上服装
meaningZh: n. 服装，装束；戏装，剧装；v. 给…穿上服装
meaningEn: n. a set of clothes worn by an actor or by someone to make them look like something such as an animal, famous person etc
example: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
exampleZh: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景
exampleEn: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets

meaning: n. 小偷，贼
meaningZh: n. 小偷，贼
meaningEn: n. someone who steals things from another person or place
example: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.
exampleZh: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。
exampleEn: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.

meaning: n. 火鸡；笨蛋；失败之作
meaningZh: n. 火鸡；笨蛋；失败之作
meaningEn: n. a bird that looks like a large chicken and is often eaten at Christmas and at Thanksgiving
example: roast turkey
exampleZh: 烤火鸡
exampleEn: roast turkey

meaning: n. [军] 机动；演习；策略；调遣；v. [军] 机动；演习；调遣；用计谋
meaningZh: n. [军] 机动；演习；策略；调遣；v. [军] 机动；演习；调遣；用计谋
meaningEn: n. a planned movement or skillful action; v. to move or guide skillfully

meaning: n. 薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物；v. 下雾；变模糊
meaningZh: n. 薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物；v. 下雾；变模糊
meaningEn: n. a light cloud low over the ground that makes it difficult for you to see very far
example: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
exampleZh: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。
exampleEn: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.

meaning: n. 弓形，拱形；拱门；adj. 主要的；v. 使…弯成弓形；用拱连接
meaningZh: n. 弓形，拱形；拱门；adj. 主要的；v. 使…弯成弓形；用拱连接
meaningEn: n. a structure with a curved top and straight sides that supports the weight of a bridge or building；v. to form or make something form a curved shape
example: When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.
exampleZh: 从通向公园外的拱门下走过时，米拉高兴地喊叫起来。
exampleEn: When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.

meaning: n. 装货；装载的货物
meaningZh: n. 装货；装载的货物
meaningEn: n. a load of goods sent by sea, road, or air, or the act of sending them
example: The goods are ready for shipment.
exampleZh: 货物已经准备好装运。
exampleEn: The goods are ready for shipment.

meaning: adj. 阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的
meaningZh: adj. 阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的
meaningEn: adj. cold and without any pleasant or comfortable features
example: a bleak January afternoon
exampleZh: 一月里一个阴冷的下午
exampleEn: a bleak January afternoon

meaning: n. 炉，灶；烤炉，烤箱
meaningZh: n. 炉，灶；烤炉，烤箱
meaningEn: n. a piece of equipment that food is cooked inside, shaped like a metal box with a door on the front
example: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
exampleZh: 把烤箱预热至200摄氏度。
exampleEn: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.

meaning: n. 虚伪；伪善
meaningZh: n. 虚伪；伪善
meaningEn: n. when someone pretends to have certain beliefs or opinions that they do not really have – used to show disapproval
example: It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.
exampleZh: 我从不相信上帝，因此为获成功而祈祷是纯粹的虚伪之举。
exampleEn: It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.

meaning: v. 解雇；卸下；放出；免除；n. 排放；卸货；解雇
meaningZh: v. 解雇；卸下；放出；免除；n. 排放；卸货；解雇
meaningEn: v. to send out gas, liquid, smoke etc, or to allow it to escape；n. when gas, liquid, smoke etc is sent out, or the substance that is sent out
example: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
exampleZh: 与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。
exampleEn: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.

meaning: n. 琐事；蛋糕；少量；v. 开玩笑；闲混；嘲弄
meaningZh: n. 琐事；蛋糕；少量；v. 开玩笑；闲混；嘲弄
meaningEn: n. something unimportant or not valuable
example: There’s no point in arguing over trifles.
exampleZh: 为琐事争吵毫无意义。
exampleEn: There’s no point in arguing over trifles.

meaning: n. 圆周；周长；胸围
meaningZh: n. 圆周；周长；胸围
meaningEn: n. the distance or measurement around the outside of a circle or any round shape
example: ...a scientist calculating the Earth's circumference.
exampleZh: …一位正在计算地球周长的科学家。
exampleEn: ...a scientist calculating the Earth's circumference.

meaning: n. 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物；v. 无性繁殖，复制
meaningZh: n. 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物；v. 无性繁殖，复制
meaningEn: n. an animal or plant produced by scientists from one cell of another animal or plant, so that they are exactly the same；v. to make an exact copy of a plant or animal by taking a cell from it and developing it artificially

meaning: v. 放牧；擦伤；n. 放牧；轻擦
meaningZh: v. 放牧；擦伤；n. 放牧；轻擦
meaningEn: v. to accidentally break the surface of your skin by rubbing it against something；n. a wound caused by rubbing that slightly breaks the surface of your skin
example: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
exampleZh: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。
exampleEn: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.

meaning: n. 地下室；地窖
meaningZh: n. 地下室；地窖
meaningEn: n. a room or area in a building that is under the level of the ground
example: They bought an old schoolhouse to live in and built a workshop in the basement.
exampleZh: 他们买了座旧校舍居住，还在地下室建了个作坊。
exampleEn: They bought an old schoolhouse to live in and built a workshop in the basement.

meaning: adj. 可比较的；比得上的
meaningZh: adj. 可比较的；比得上的
meaningEn: adj. similar to something else in size, number, quality etc, so that you can make a comparison
example: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
exampleZh: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。
exampleEn: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.

meaning: n. 二月
meaningZh: n. 二月
meaningEn: n. February is the second month of the year in the Western calendar
example: He joined the Army in February 1943.
exampleZh: 他1943年2月参军。
exampleEn: He joined the Army in February 1943.

meaning: n. [电] 电压
meaningZh: n. [电] 电压
meaningEn: n. electrical force measured in volts
example: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
exampleZh: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。
exampleEn: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.

meaning: adj. 乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的；n. 器乐曲；工具字，工具格
meaningZh: adj. 乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的；n. 器乐曲；工具字，工具格
meaningEn: adj. instrumental music is for instruments, not for voices；n. a piece of music in which no voices are used, only instruments
example: ...a CD of vocal and instrumental music.
exampleZh: …一张声乐和器乐光盘。
exampleEn: ...a CD of vocal and instrumental music.

meaning: n. 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号；vt. 紧握；握成拳；用拳打
meaningZh: n. 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号；vt. 紧握；握成拳；用拳打
meaningEn: n. the hand when it is tightly closed, so that the fingers are curled in towards the  palm  . People close their hand in a fist when they are angry or are going to hit someone.
example: She held the money tightly in her fist.
exampleZh: 她把钱紧紧地攥在手中。
exampleEn: She held the money tightly in her fist.

meaning: n. 胡萝卜
meaningZh: n. 胡萝卜
meaningEn: n. a long pointed orange vegetable that grows under the ground
example: grated carrots
exampleZh: 磨碎的胡萝卜
exampleEn: grated carrots

meaning: v. 旋，拧；压榨；强迫；n. 螺旋；螺丝钉；吝啬鬼
meaningZh: v. 旋，拧；压榨；强迫；n. 螺旋；螺丝钉；吝啬鬼
meaningEn: v. to fasten or close something by turning it, or to be fastened in this way；n. a thin pointed piece of metal that you push and turn in order to fasten pieces of metal or wood together
example: "Yes, I know that," Kelly said, screwing the silencer onto the pistol.
exampleZh: “是的，我知道那事。”凯利一边把消音器拧到手枪上一边说道。
exampleEn: "Yes, I know that," Kelly said, screwing the silencer onto the pistol.

meaning: n. 大腿，股
meaningZh: n. 大腿，股
meaningEn: n. the top part of your leg, between your knee and your  hip
example: chicken thighs
exampleZh: 鸡腿
exampleEn: chicken thighs

meaning: adj. 可怕的；极讨厌的
meaningZh: adj. 可怕的；极讨厌的
meaningEn: adj. very bad - used, for example, about things you see, taste, or smell, or about the weather
example: The weather has been really horrible all week.
exampleZh: 整个星期天气都很糟。
exampleEn: The weather has been really horrible all week.

meaning: n. 油；石油；油画颜料；v. 加油；涂油；使融化
meaningZh: n. 油；石油；油画颜料；v. 加油；涂油；使融化
meaningEn: n. the thick dark liquid from under the ground from which petrol is produced；v. to put oil onto part of a machine or part of something that moves, to help it to move or work more smoothly
example: a rise in the price of oil
exampleZh: 石油价格的上涨
exampleEn: a rise in the price of oil

meaning: n. 导弹；投射物；adj. 导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的
meaningZh: n. 导弹；投射物；adj. 导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的
meaningEn: n. a weapon that can fly over long distances and that explodes when it hits the thing it has been aimed at
example: a nuclear missile
exampleZh: 核导弹
exampleEn: a nuclear missile

meaning: v. 退还；偿还，归还；n. 退款；偿还，偿还额
meaningZh: v. 退还；偿还，归还；n. 退款；偿还，偿还额
meaningEn: v. to give someone their money back, especially because they are not satisfied with the goods or services they have paid for；n. an amount of money that is given back to you if you are not satisfied with the goods or services that you have paid for
example: I took the radio back, and they refunded my money .
exampleZh: 我把收音机送回去，他们给我退了款。
exampleEn: I took the radio back, and they refunded my money .

meaning: adj. [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的；n. 雨天；湿气；v. 弄湿
meaningZh: adj. [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的；n. 雨天；湿气；v. 弄湿
meaningEn: adj. covered in or full of water or another liquid；n. the rain；v. to make something wet
example: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.
exampleZh: 我把你的衬衫洗过了，不过现在还是湿的。
exampleEn: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.

meaning: adj. 健全的；理智的；[临床] 神志正常的；n. (Sane)人名；(日)实(姓)；(日)实(名)；(芬、塞、冈、几比、塞内)萨内
meaningZh: adj. 健全的；理智的；[临床] 神志正常的；n. (Sane)人名；(日)实(姓)；(日)实(名)；(芬、塞、冈、几比、塞内)萨内
meaningEn: adj. able to think in a normal and reasonable way
example: He seems perfectly sane (= completely sane ) to me.
exampleZh: 在我看来他神志完全正常。
exampleEn: He seems perfectly sane (= completely sane ) to me.

meaning: n. 沙；沙地；沙洲；沙滩；沙子；v. 撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子
meaningZh: n. 沙；沙地；沙洲；沙滩；沙子；v. 撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子
meaningEn: n. a substance consisting of very small pieces of rocks and minerals, that forms beaches and deserts；v. to make a surface smooth by rubbing it with  sandpaper  or using a special piece of equipment
example: a mixture of sand and cement
exampleZh: 沙和水泥的混合物
exampleEn: a mixture of sand and cement

meaning: n. 楼梯，阶梯；梯级
meaningZh: n. 楼梯，阶梯；梯级
meaningEn: n. a set of steps built for going from one level of a building to another
example: We walked up four flights of stairs (= sets of stairs ) .
exampleZh: 我们往上走了四段楼梯。
exampleEn: We walked up four flights of stairs (= sets of stairs ) .

meaning: n. 蒸气（等于vapor）；水蒸气
meaningZh: n. 蒸气（等于vapor）；水蒸气
meaningEn: n. a mass of very small drops of a liquid which float in the air, for example because the liquid has been heated
example: water vapour
exampleZh: 水蒸气
exampleEn: water vapour

meaning: v. 统一；使相同，使一致
meaningZh: v. 统一；使相同，使一致
meaningEn: v. if you unify two or more parts or things, or if they unify, they are combined to make a single unit
example: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
exampleZh: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。
exampleEn: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.

meaning: n. 内地；内陆；adj. 内陆的；内地的；国内的；adv. 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆
meaningZh: n. 内地；内陆；adj. 内陆的；内地的；国内的；adv. 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆
meaningEn: adj. an inland area, city etc is not near the coast；adv. in a direction away from the coast and towards the centre of a country
example: The next day, we drove inland.
exampleZh: 第二天，我们乘车开往内陆。
exampleEn: The next day, we drove inland.

meaning: n. [化学] 氢
meaningZh: n. [化学] 氢
meaningEn: n. Hydrogen is a colourless gas that is the lightest and commonest element in the universe
example: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
exampleZh: 水含有氢和氧。
exampleEn: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.

meaning: adj. 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的
meaningZh: adj. 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的
meaningEn: adj. able to learn and understand things quickly
example: a clever man
exampleZh: 聪明的人
exampleEn: a clever man

meaning: v. 繁殖；饲养；产生；n. [生物] 品种；种类，类型
meaningZh: v. 繁殖；饲养；产生；n. [生物] 品种；种类，类型
meaningEn: v. if animals breed, they  mate  in order to have babies；n. a type of animal that is kept as a pet or on a farm
example: Eagles breed during the cooler months of the year.
exampleZh: 鹰在一年中较凉爽的季节交配繁殖。
exampleEn: Eagles breed during the cooler months of the year.

meaning: adv. 总是；不变地；一定地
meaningZh: adv. 总是；不变地；一定地
meaningEn: adv. if something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is true
example: It invariably rains when I go there.
exampleZh: 我每次去那儿都下雨。
exampleEn: It invariably rains when I go there.

meaning: n. 演讲；讲稿；教训；v. 演讲；训诫
meaningZh: n. 演讲；讲稿；教训；v. 演讲；训诫
meaningEn: n. a long talk on a particular subject that someone gives to a group of people, especially to students in a university；v. to talk to a group of people on a particular subject, especially to students in a university
example: ...a series of lectures by Professor Eric Robinson.
exampleZh: …埃里克·鲁滨逊教授的系列讲座。
exampleEn: ...a series of lectures by Professor Eric Robinson.

meaning: n. 货摊；畜栏；托辞；v. 停止，停转；拖延
meaningZh: n. 货摊；畜栏；托辞；v. 停止，停转；拖延
meaningEn: n. a table or a small shop with an open front, especially outdoors, where goods are sold；v. if an engine or vehicle stalls, or if you stall it, it stops because there is not enough power or speed to keep it going
example: a market stall
exampleZh: 市场摊位
exampleEn: a market stall

meaning: n. 暴风雪；雪暴
meaningZh: n. 暴风雪；雪暴
meaningEn: n. a storm with strong winds and a lot of snow
example: The snowstorm added to our difficulties.
exampleZh: 暴风雪增加了我们的困难。
exampleEn: The snowstorm added to our difficulties.

meaning: n. 边界；范围；分界线
meaningZh: n. 边界；范围；分界线
meaningEn: n. the real or imaginary line that marks the edge of a state, country etc, or the edge of an area of land that belongs to someone
example: National boundaries are becoming increasingly meaningless in the global economy.
exampleZh: 在全球经济中，国界已经变得越来越没有意义。
exampleEn: National boundaries are becoming increasingly meaningless in the global economy.

meaning: n. 黑人；adj. 黑人的
meaningZh: n. 黑人；adj. 黑人的
meaningEn: n. A Negro is someone with dark skin who comes from Africa or whose ancestors came from Africa；adj. relating to or characteristic of Negroes
example: Slavery was “an unqualified evil to the negro, the white man, and the State,” said Abraham Lincoln in the 1850s.
exampleZh: 奴隶制，“对于黑人、白人与合众国来说都是一种彻底的邪恶，”1850年林肯如此说道。
exampleEn: Slavery was “an unqualified evil to the negro, the white man, and the State,” said Abraham Lincoln in the 1850s.

meaning: n. 暂停；间歇；v. 暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇
meaningZh: n. 暂停；间歇；v. 暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇
meaningEn: n. a short time during which someone stops speaking or doing something before starting again；v. to stop speaking or doing something for a short time before starting again
example: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
exampleZh: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。
exampleEn: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.

meaning: n. 投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所；v. 投票；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票；adj. 无角的；剪过毛的；修过枝的
meaningZh: n. 投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所；v. 投票；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票；adj. 无角的；剪过毛的；修过枝的
meaningEn: n. the process of finding out what people think about something by asking many people the same question, or the record of the result；v. to ask a lot of people the same questions in order to find out what they think about a subject
example: A recent poll found that 80% of Californians support the governor.
